shape: Monorepo: Next.js App Router frontend under web/, FastAPI backend under api/ (Python), Supabase migrations under supabase/.
whyThisShape: The honest-coverage case, and the sharpest test in the set. Roughly forty route handlers live in Python that no parser reads. Every claim the package makes about 'the backend' is therefore about code it never saw, and silence about that reads as 'this repo has no backend'. This is the fixture that makes the parsed-vs-in-scope distinction load-bearing.
labeledFrom: Enumerated web/app/**/page.tsx, confirmed api/ is FastAPI (Python); domain nouns from web/app/app/* route names and supabase/migrations.
